focused.description: Landing pequeña o validación rápida. Conserva todas las fases con evidencia compacta.
focused.design_evidence: hero, key sections, mobile composition and representative build
focused.qa_scope: primary action and representative viewport/browser checks

standard.description: Landing de marca o campaña con dirección y validación visual completas.
standard.design_evidence: complete landing, responsive states and defining interactions
standard.qa_scope: full page, responsive/browser checks and included form states

extended.description: Landing crítica, inmersiva o con producción visual compleja. Amplía evidencia, no el alcance funcional.
extended.design_evidence: expanded scenes, visual pressure tests and risky interaction prototypes
extended.qa_scope: expanded viewports, media, fallbacks and interaction failure modes
